results.title: Application starts and home page loads
results.procedure: Open http://127.0.0.1:5057/ in the browser.
results.expected: HTTP 200, page title 'USER LOGIN', login form (e-mail, password, LOGIN) visible.
results.actual: HTTP 200; title 'USER LOGIN'; header shows 'USER LOGIN v1.1'; login form visible: True.

results.title: Register page is reachable from the login page
results.procedure: On the login page click the 'Register here' link.
results.expected: Browser goes to /register and the CREATE ACCOUNT form is displayed.
results.actual: URL is http://127.0.0.1:5057/register; register form visible: True.

results.title: Stylesheet loads
results.procedure: Request /static/css/w3.css.
results.expected: HTTP 200 and CSS content returned.
results.actual: HTTP 200; stylesheet contains the w3-* classes: True.

results.title: Critical path: seeded user can log in
results.procedure: Enter alpha@uc.com / hello123 on the login page and press LOGIN.
results.expected: User is taken to /main and the students table is shown.
results.actual: Landed on http://127.0.0.1:5057/main; students table visible: True.

results.title: Footer shows the correct copyright name
results.procedure: Open the login page and read the footer.
results.expected: Footer reads 'Copyright © Mandawe, Ivan Jae D. 2026'.
results.actual: Footer text: 'Copyright © Mandawe, Ivan Jae D. 2026'.

results.title: Register with valid details
results.procedure: Open /register; enter Name 'Juan Dela Cruz', E-mail juan@uc.com, Password Passw0rd! (twice); press REGISTER.
results.expected: Redirected to login page with a green 'Registration successful' message; one new row saved in the users table.
results.actual: Now on http://127.0.0.1:5057/; message: 'Registration successful. You can now log in.'; rows in users for juan@uc.com: 1.

results.title: Login with a newly registered account
results.procedure: Register ana@uc.com, then log in with ana@uc.com / Passw0rd!.
results.expected: Redirected to /main; header shows 'Welcome, Ana Reyes'.
results.actual: URL http://127.0.0.1:5057/main; header text: 'Welcome, Ana Reyes'.

results.title: Login with a wrong password
results.procedure: Enter alpha@uc.com with password 'wrongpass' and press LOGIN.
results.expected: Login refused; red 'Invalid e-mail or password.' message; /main stays inaccessible.
results.actual: Message: 'Invalid e-mail or password.'; /main redirected to login: True.

results.title: Login with an unregistered e-mail
results.procedure: Enter nobody@uc.com / Passw0rd! and press LOGIN.
results.expected: Login refused with the same generic 'Invalid e-mail or password.' message.
results.actual: Message: 'Invalid e-mail or password.'; URL http://127.0.0.1:5057/.

results.title: Register with an e-mail that already exists
results.procedure: Register beto@uc.com once, then register beto@uc.com again with another name.
results.expected: Second attempt refused with 'That e-mail is already registered.'; only one row exists.
results.actual: Message: 'That e-mail is already registered.'; rows with that e-mail: 1.

results.title: Register with mismatched passwords
results.procedure: Register carla@uc.com with Password 'Passw0rd!' and Confirm 'Different1!'.
results.expected: Refused with 'Passwords do not match.'; no row saved; entered name/e-mail are kept in the form.
results.actual: Message: 'Passwords do not match.'; rows saved: 0; e-mail field kept: True.

results.title: Required field validation (server side)
results.procedure: Send a registration request with an empty Name field (bypassing the browser's 'required' check).
results.expected: Refused with 'All fields are required.'; no row saved.
results.actual: Response contains the required-fields message: True; rows saved: 0.

results.title: Logout
results.procedure: Log in as alpha@uc.com, then click LOG-OUT.
results.expected: Redirected to the login page with 'You have been logged out.'; /main is no longer accessible.
results.actual: After logout URL http://127.0.0.1:5057/; message 'You have been logged out.'; /main now redirects to login: True.

results.title: Protected page without logging in
results.procedure: In a new browser session open /main directly.
results.expected: Redirected to login page with 'Please log in first.'
results.actual: URL http://127.0.0.1:5057/; message 'Please log in first.'.

results.title: Main page lists all students
results.procedure: Log in as alpha@uc.com and view /main.
results.expected: Table shows a header row plus 6 student rows (IDNO 1000-1005).
results.actual: Table rows counted (including header): 7.

results.title: Session persists after page refresh
results.procedure: Log in, then press the browser refresh button on /main.
results.expected: User remains logged in and the table is still shown.
results.actual: After reload URL http://127.0.0.1:5057/main; table visible: True.

results.title: 'Back to login' link on the register page
results.procedure: Open /register and click 'Back to login'.
results.expected: Login page is displayed.
results.actual: URL http://127.0.0.1:5057/; login form visible: True.

results.title: Performance: page response time
results.procedure: Request /, /register and /main five times each and measure the average response time.
results.expected: Average response time under 1000 ms for every page.
results.actual: /: avg 12 ms; /register: avg 8 ms; /main: avg 4 ms.

results.title: Security: passwords are stored hashed
results.procedure: Register hash@uc.com with password 'Passw0rd!' and inspect the saved row in the database.
results.expected: The stored value is a salted hash, never the plain-text password.
results.actual: Stored value starts with 'scrypt:32768:8:1$h4c…' (162 characters); plain text not present.

results.title: Security: SQL injection on login
results.procedure: Send a login request with e-mail  ' OR '1'='1  and any password.
results.expected: Login refused; no session created.
results.actual: Response contained 'Invalid e-mail or password.': True; /main reachable afterwards: False.

results.title: Security: script injection (XSS) in the name field
results.procedure: Register with the name  <script>document.title='HACKED'</script>,  log in and view /main.
results.expected: The text is shown as plain text (escaped); no script runs; page title unchanged.
results.actual: Page title 'USER LOGIN'; header shows literal text: 'Welcome, <script>document.title='HACKED'</script>'.

results.title: Security: Back button after logout
results.procedure: Log in, open /main, click LOG-OUT, then press the browser Back button.
results.expected: Protected content is not shown again; user is sent back to the login page. /main is sent with no-store headers.
results.actual: Cache-Control on /main: 'no-cache, no-store, must-revalidate'; students table visible after Back: False; URL http://127.0.0.1:5057/.

results.title: Security: session cookie flags
results.procedure: Log in and inspect the 'session' cookie.
results.expected: Cookie exists and is flagged HttpOnly (not readable by JavaScript).
results.actual: Session cookie present: True; HttpOnly: True.

results.title: Usability: mobile layout (375 px wide)
results.procedure: Resize the viewport to 375 x 667 and open the login and register pages.
results.expected: No horizontal scrolling; form fits inside the screen.
results.actual: /register: page width 375px, form right edge 359px; /: page width 375px, form right edge 359px (limit 375px).

results.title: Reliability: 25 consecutive logins
results.procedure: Send 25 valid login requests one after another.
results.expected: All requests succeed with no server error (HTTP 5xx).
results.actual: 25 requests, statuses [200]; server errors: 0.

results.title: Same e-mail typed with different letter case
results.procedure: Register Case@Test.com, then try to register case@test.com.
results.expected: Second registration refused (e-mail addresses are not case-sensitive).
results.actual: Message: 'That e-mail is already registered.'; accounts now stored for this address: 1.

results.title: Log in using different letter case than at registration
results.procedure: Register Mixed@Case.com, then log in with mixed@case.com.
results.expected: Login succeeds.
results.actual: URL after login: http://127.0.0.1:5057/main; message: ''.

results.title: Name made only of spaces
results.procedure: Register with Name '   ' (three spaces), valid e-mail and password.
results.expected: Registration refused (a name is required).
results.actual: Rows saved with a blank name: 0.

results.title: Very short password
results.procedure: Register with the one-character password 'a' (and confirmation 'a').
results.expected: Registration refused with a message about minimum password length.
results.actual: Message: 'Password must be at least 8 characters long.'; rows saved with a 1-character password: 0.

results.title: E-mail typed with extra spaces
results.procedure: Send a registration with e-mail '  space@test.com  ' (spaces before and after).
results.expected: Spaces are removed before saving (stored e-mail is 'space@test.com').
results.actual: Stored e-mail value: 'space@test.com'.

results.title: Logged-in user opens the login/register pages
results.procedure: Log in, then type / (and /register) in the address bar.
results.expected: User is sent straight to /main instead of seeing the login form again.
results.actual: Opening '/' ended at http://127.0.0.1:5057/main; opening '/register' ended at http://127.0.0.1:5057/main.

results.title: Extremely long name (200 characters)
results.procedure: Register with a 200-character name.
results.expected: Refused with a message (database column allows 50 characters).
results.actual: Message: 'Name and e-mail must be 50 characters or less.'; rows saved: 0; longest stored name length: None.

results.title: Open /userlogin directly in the address bar
results.procedure: Type /userlogin (a POST-only route) in the address bar.
results.expected: Server handles it without crashing (405 Method Not Allowed is acceptable).
results.actual: HTTP 405 (no server crash).

results.title: Open a page that does not exist
results.procedure: Open /abc123.
results.expected: HTTP 404 page, application keeps running.
results.actual: HTTP 404.

results.title: Open /logout without being logged in
results.procedure: In a new session open /logout.
results.expected: No error; user lands on the login page.
results.actual: HTTP 200; login form visible: True.

results.title: Name with accents and emoji
results.procedure: Register the name 'José Núñez 😀', log in and look at the welcome text.
results.expected: Name is saved and displayed correctly.
results.actual: Header text: 'Welcome, José Núñez 😀'.

results.title: Double submit of the register form
results.procedure: Send the same registration twice at the same moment.
results.expected: Only one account is created; no server error.
results.actual: Accounts created: 1; HTTP 200 and 200.
